The '''Justicars' Tower''', also known as the '''Justicar Detention Center''', was an abandoned [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] facility utilized by the [[Justicars' Brigade]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In the aftermath of the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] resources were severely limited and Coruscant Security [[Police officer/Legends|Forces]] were pulled from the area. In the ensuing chaos, gangs such as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] moved in praying on the helpless [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]]. Angered by returning to homes and communities under siege, ex-[[Republic soldier]]s formed their own [[Militia/Legends|militia]] calling themselves the Justicars' Brigade.<ref name="SWTORJusticarcodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Justicars}}</ref> They fought back the gangs and took control of an area known as [[Justicar territory]]. Seizing the abandoned CSF facility, they renamed it the Justicars' Tower and utilized it has their headquarters.<ref name="SWTOREG" /> From here the Justicars ran their operations and maintained a prison facility where they would place persons they arrested.<ref name="SWTORJusticarsec">{{TORcite|type=location|Justicars' Sector|Coruscant}}</ref> During the early days of the [[Desolator crisis]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] [[Mission to Justicar territory|raided]] the facility to locate the research team for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], only to find that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] had massacred the group and stolen the prototype.
